name: Prairie Knights Marina RV Park
note: The Prairie Knights resort's campground at its Lake Oahe marina (Standing Rock Sioux Tribe), about 4.5 km east of the casino's RV lot: one loop of back-in concrete spurs on open grass above the boat ramp and marina parking, with shared water and a dump station rather than water at the sites. Primitive tent sites are booked by phone with the lodge. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator marina page (prairieknights.com/stay-prairie-knights-casino/marina/, read 2026-11-12): '32 full RV sites plus additional tent camping sites', 'Restrooms with showers and a convenient fish cleaning station', '16 additional RV sites located at Prairie Knights Casino & Resort', own 'Marina Map' (marina-map-800.jpg) drawing 32 numbered back-in spurs on a loop, comfort station, restrooms/showers/changing rooms, fish cleaning station/RV dump and a separate 'Marina Entrance' with security building; the resort's Windsurfer booking engine (propertyID 17385, getresultd for Tue 2026-11-17, read 2026-11-12) sells 'MARINA RV SITE 1'-'32' individually under rate 'Prairie Knights Marina View RV Park' $20.00 + $1.05 Standing Rock tribal sales tax, described as '32 seasonal back-in RV sites located along the Missouri River 5 miles on a gravel road southeast of the casino. Each site comes with a concrete pad and electric (30/50 amp)'; 'There are no weekly or monthly rates'; Esri imagery (WV02 2025-10-06) shows the loop of ~32 paved spurs with grass islands and trees, a restroom building and an access road of its own, 4.5 km E of 5948's casino lot; engine site photos show pads with picnic tables, fire rings and electric pedestals -> a real campground, not a casino or marina parking lot; private price gate: $20 < US$50 passes; presence: operator site + phone + live booking engine
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery, current release = Maxar WV02 0.5 m captured 2025-10-06 (wb.py), 800 m and 400 m frames at 46.2662,-100.5812 and 46.2668,-100.5795. The loop sits on open mown grass with scattered young trees on the slope above the marina; its east-row pads are ~200-215 m from the October 2025 waterline (~180 m from the riprap/erosion bank top), and between them lie the marina access road, more open lawn, a picnic shelter pad, the 90-space ramp parking lot and a strip of unmown brush down the bank -> not on-water (distance far past ~50 m, plus road and day-use between). Open-ground floor: no treeline or berm screens the loop from the lake; DEM (Open-Meteo) 503-504 m at the loop, 500 and 496 m on the slope below, 488 m on the open water, so the pads look down ~15 m over open grass onto Lake Oahe (several km wide here) -> lakeview. Lake Oahe's pool swings by metres; a lower pool moves the waterline further out but the reservoir stays in view from that height. On the reservoir itself (Oahe Dam is ~300 km south in SD), not below a dam. Operator site photos (Windsurfer MRV1, MRV9) face into the pads toward the hills and neither show nor rule out the water; the marina map draws the RV loop inland of the road and parking.

fees.note: $20 a night plus the Standing Rock tribal sales tax; full prepayment, non-refundable. Resort booking engine, read 2026-11-12.

booking.note: Booked through the resort's lodge reservations; RV sites are prepaid in full and non-refundable. Tent sites by phone only.

Check in time: 2pm, Check out time: 1pm. Reservations are non-refundable.') and marina room description ('Primitive tent camping is available at the marina. sites.note: 32 back-in RV sites with concrete pads and 30/50-amp electric; primitive tent sites besides, count not published.

rvlife: not listed (RV Life Algolia park index, 8 km radius and 'prairie knights' query, read 2026-11-12: only 5948's casino listing 4*/$$ and 5909 Beaver Creek)
flags: Separate from 5948: 4.5 km apart (5948's casino RV lot is at 46.27205,-100.63885); the marina has its own entrance road off the resort ('Marina Entrance' and security building on the operator's map; the engine: '5 miles on a gravel road southeast of the casino'), its own restrooms/showers, and the engine sells the two as separate site types (CASINO RV SITE 1-16 at $40 vs MARINA RV SITE 1-32 at $20). Not a parking lot: 32 numbered back-in spurs on a grass loop with tables, fire rings and pedestals.

Ownership private, same as 5948 (Standing Rock Sioux Tribe's resort enterprise; no source says otherwise). Neither the marina nor the casino lot is on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025) - tribal land, outside state licensing - so that check can't confirm it either way.

Price read for a November 2026 weeknight only ($20); 2027 nights are not loaded in the engine yet, so the summer rate is unconfirmed. The marina's single rate code reads as a flat rate, and the casino lot is $40, so the gate is safe either way.

Hookups: electric 50 from the engine's '(30/50 amp)'. Water and sewer left absent (unknown) though the engine's wording ('There is access to fresh water and a dumping station') implies no water or sewer at the sites; the operator's '32 full RV sites' is the only hint otherwise.
Season left absent: the engine calls them '32 seasonal back-in RV sites' yet sells nights for 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-15; no open/close dates are published. Shared water is probably off in winter.

Name: the operator page calls it 'The Marina at Prairie Knights' / 'Prairie Knights Marina'; the rate code is 'Prairie Knights Marina View RV Park'; Google (per the 5948 verify scan, 2026-11-12) lists it as 'Prairie Knights RV Park' (4.7, 12 reviews, 701-854-7777, at the marina). Chose 'Prairie Knights Marina RV Park'; rename if AWH prefers.
Pin at the RV loop's centre on 2025-10-06 imagery (46.2662,-100.5812, the lead's point); the marina entrance is ~600 m S and the boat ramp ~450 m N.

Waterfront lakeview rests on imagery + DEM geometry (open slope, ~15 m above the lake, ~200 m off), not on a photo from a site; the engine's site photos face away from the lake. 'Marina View' in the rate name was not used as evidence.
No duplicate: nearest DB entries are 5948 (4.5 km W) and 5909 Beaver Creek (USACE, across the lake on ND 1804, 4.1 km SE). Not on RV Life. No horse camping. ndtourism.com not used.
